newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: FDA okays Novartis' Neoral for two new indications.
newsitem.headline: FDA okays Novartis' Neoral for two new indications.

text.p: Life sciences group Novartis International AG said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) had cleared its drug Neoral for the treatment of severe active rheumatoid arthritis and for severe recalcitrant plaque psoriasis.
Neoral has been available in the U.S. since 1995 as an immunosuppressive agent to prevent rejection of transplanted organs, Novartis said in a statement.
Rheumatoid arthritis is a debilitating systemic disease characterised by chronic joint inflammation that almost always lead to deformities and disability.
It strikes some 2.3 million Americans, 10-15 percent of whom are severely affected and receive immunosuppressive therapy, Novartis said.
